cells.gaps: Only the capital records: SYCOTAX runs in Ouagadougou's markets, in pilot markets in March 2024 and November 2025, and no other commune is named. Where the record is held is not stated, and no plan, finance or count of communes is given. State tax services also run tax billing and collection for the collectivités territoriales.
cells.note: Ouagadougou's SYCOTAX records market traders and their payments (BFA-001, BFA-003), but only the capital records, which the ladder places at stage 2. Stage 3 needs a system live in local governments outside the capital.
